craft_notes: Sthāyin: chief instruments; crippled unbroken. Rows: chiefs, I-ness, foot, no-break. Read aloud: full muster.

lines: And the maker-part is I-maker alone; by that two chief engines:
in knowing, knowing; in doing, doing-power;
for blind and lame, unfallen from I-formed knowing-doing;
but from the bright alone, part-excelling in subtles, the I-maker —
fit for deed and engine; foot-engine its chief seat without,
elsewhere too that is indeed — so not even of the halt is going broke.
l4.sanskrit_cite: kartraṃśaś ca ahaṃkāra eva tena mukhye karaṇe dve puṃsaḥ jñāne vidyā kriyāyāṃ kalā andhasya paṅgoś ca ahaṃtārūpajñānakriyānapagamāt udriktatanmātrabhāgaviśiṣṭāt tu sāttvikād eva ahaṃkārāt karmendriyapañcakam ahaṃ gacchāmi iti ahaṃkāraviśiṣṭaḥ kāryakaraṇakṣamaḥ pādendriyaṃ tasya mukhyādhiṣṭhānaṃ bāhyam anyatrāpi tad asty eva iti rugṇasyāpi na gativicchedaḥ
